title: In-App Update Apply Reliability and Release Closeout Hardening
summary: Hardens in-app update apply with fresh trusted check snapshots, provider retry, truthful release tag evidence, API-visible release identity closeout validation and operator-facing snapshot recovery UX.
changelog: Keeps Apply usable from a fresh trusted Check snapshot after transient public provider failures.
Adds bounded retry/backoff and safer timeout handling for public release metadata reads.
Reports trusted apply candidate source/freshness in update status, apply request and history.
Blocks stale, mismatched, missing or installed-drift update evidence before helper request creation.
Clarifies Settings Maintenance messages for provider failures, stale checks and missing trusted commit evidence.
Corrects release evidence contract so commit trust comes from validated immutable semver tags.
Ensures release publish/check helpers do not mutate descriptor files after successful validation.
Strengthens terminal/helper closeout tests for API-visible release identity completeness and commit verification.
